run.name: Wayfair Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (W)
run.summary: Wayfair is a stronger credit than two years ago, with total debt to Adjusted EBITDA at 3.28x against 6.88x in FY2024, but it remains a thin-margin, demand-sensitive retailer whose leverage looks moderate only on company-defined earnings. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Net revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (operating income plus D&A), calculated, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 2,799 (Q3 10-Q page:11) over derived LTM Adjusted EBITDA 853; net debt deducts 1,098; Adjusted EBITDA adds back equity compensation, so unadjusted leverage is higher (5.10x total debt on operating income plus D&A)

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Derived LTM Adjusted EBITDA 853 over derived LTM cash interest 170 (139 plus 129 less 98); cash interest is gross of interest income; cover on run-rate coupons of about 195 is 4.36x

cash.basis: Cash. 500 less 82 letters of credit (Q3 10-Q page:11); short-term investments of 60 excluded; availability is arithmetic and is not tested against covenants

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant terms, ratings and executed debt documents are not supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA adds back equity compensation, so headroom and downside cannot be measured precisely.
CP-1 main limitation: Earnings are company-adjusted and add back equity compensation; covenant definitions and market data are not supplied, so headroom and relative value cannot be measured.
